completed_items: CheckoutFormGroup with floating labels and validation
design_fidelity_notes: Implemented 'Liquid Glass' aesthetic using backdrop-filter and WebGL shader background.
Typography follows Inter/System font stack as requested.
Colors match the design system palette.

interaction_completeness.navigation: Implemented React Router with Framer Motion page transitions.
interaction_completeness.filtering: Search bar updates store, triggers graph view switch.
interaction_completeness.forms: Checkout form has focus states and basic validation hooks.
interaction_completeness.component_communication: Zustand store coordinates search -> graph -> detail view.
interaction_completeness.modal_overlay: Search bar expands with overlay; Graph view acts as a full-screen overlay.

generative_visual_notes: Implemented custom GLSL shader for the liquid background (Mode A).
Used D3 force simulation for the Knowledge Graph (Mode B).
Combined standard DOM UI with Canvas/WebGL layers.
interaction_fidelity_notes: Shared element transitions partially simulated via Framer Motion layoutId.
a11y_notes: Semantic HTML structure used where possible.
Contrast ratios generally good, though glass effects need testing.
performance_notes: WebGL background is heavy; should check performance on low-end devices.
D3 simulation runs in a loop; optimized by using Canvas instead of SVG for nodes.
known_gaps: Shared element transition for the search bar -> graph is simplified.
